title: Prove the symbolic agreement core of the two-target compact switch
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with finite corroboration. For the two-target compact-switch word with constant source bits `(1,1)`, binary control radix `B` and window modulus `N>B`, the maximal invariant agreement core is

```text
u0 < B-1,  t0 < B-1,  t1 < B-1,  W0 + t0 < N
```

A carry calculation proves necessity and sufficiency on both points of each ideal XOR orbit. The core excludes any four-entry independent translation menu at `B>=4`. Five entries are optimal when `B>=8` and `5(B-2)<=N`, with an invariant selector.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. It answers the symbolic-core question in #7197 and credits its finite core and four-entry adversary. zhaobenny's #6812 supplies the raw word and five-phase upper construction. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19717713)

## Evidence

- The direct checker compares 984,064 packed inputs with the formula across five new radix and width pairs. It finds 534,112 invariant agreements. Three grids range over complete dirty fields and two use stated upper-field representatives.
- All 557,056 relevant coordinate tuples in the two checked cover geometries admit a phase. Removing the last phase misses 72 tuples at `(B,N)=(8,64)` and 168 at `(16,128)`. Seven controls include an agreement whose ideal mate fails and a case whose error wraps at `N=B`.
- The warning-strict normal and optimized commands take 1.56 s and 1.52 s locally and produce identical hash-bound reports. Registered replay and committed-byte/source-history preflight pass for all six package files. The selected baseline passes its metadata bindings.

Run from the repository root. Local environment was CPython 3.12.15 on macOS 27.0.1 arm64 with the standard library.

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/compact-two-target-symbolic-core/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/compact-two-target-symbolic-core/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/compact-two-target-symbolic-core
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/compact-two-target-symbolic-core --check-source-history
```

## Limitations

The proof fixes the two target positions, the all-one source pair, two-digit control fields and the live-digit word. The menu bound requires independent coordinate translations and an invariant selector. Movement, physical selection and cleanup, tape, precision, hosting and the complete recursive bill remain open. The prior finite census, selected scientific cold replay, Lean and Docker were outside this run. This result supplies no new κ. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Derive the invariant core for a constant source pair with one zero bit. Begin by calculating the net lower-window and temporary changes when the low parity stays fixed.
- Find the minimum translation menu for `B>=4` outside the five-phase packing range. Begin with the four restored coordinates at `B=4, N=8`, where the lower bound still applies.

## Related open work

- [#7197](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7197) proves the core and five-entry minimum at `B=8, N=32` by finite methods. Substituting those parameters in the symbolic formula gives the same predicate. The predecessor census was not replayed.
